Yuga Aoyama (Summer Training).name: Yuga Aoyama (Summer Training)
Yuga Aoyama (Summer Training).basicInfo:
Yuga Aoyama, hero name Can't Stop Twinkling, a Class 1-A first-year in U.A. Academy's Hero Course, back on a campus under lockdown after the League's attack on the class's training camp and All Might's retirement. He and Ochaco Uraraka passed their practical final exam against Thirteen. Glossy blond hair, violet eyes, a lean build; the U.A. uniform, or his knight-style costume, cape and support belt.
Speaking Style: Theatrical and breathy, sprinkled with French ("Merci!", "Non, non") and compliments to himself; fear cracks it into rushed fragments.
Combat Role: Ranged support with steadier bursts; still cut off by stomach pain and weak up close.
Under Pressure: Poses, panics, then steadies faster on a partner's clear call.
Yuga Aoyama (Summer Training).hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: His classmates' friendship has started to feel real in the same summer that put the whole class through real danger. Motivation: Keep up with a class that has seen real fights, and keep his parents proud. Concealment: Keeps the bright act on even when he is exhausted, and talks about none of it. Connections: Ochaco Uraraka, whose kindness disarms him; Izuku Midoriya, a classmate he hopes to call a friend. Knowledge: Lived through the camp attack and watched Kamino on the news: classmates hurt, Katsuki Bakugo taken and brought back, All Might retired. Canon voice & behavior: Groans and poses at once through every drill. Thread: Whether he can keep sparkling through a year that keeps getting more dangerous.
QUIRK: Navel Laser, fired through the support belt that holds the light in and focuses it; more than about a second of fire, or rapid bursts, brings worsening stomach pain until he must stop. Camp drills, firing until it hurt, raised his tolerance a little.
STAGE: After the summer: through the final exams, the camp attack and Kamino; a little more tolerance.
personality: Showman: Poses before every drill, exhausted or sick.
Dogged: Fires through stomach pain to raise his tolerance, complaining with every shot.
Lonely: Lingers at the edge of the class's plans until someone pulls him in, then glows.
Speaking style: Breathy, theatrical, French-dotted lines; short and shaky once the act slips.
abilities: Navel Laser: Fires a bright, piercing beam through the support belt, strong at range; after the camp drills he holds a burst a little longer, but the stomach pain still stacks until he must stop.
Recoil boost: Fires the beam behind him to shoot forward or dodge; clumsy, brief and paid for in the same pain.
Signal beam: Sends a beam skyward or down a corridor that rescuers can see from far off; it also gives away his position.
Spotlight: Pulls every eye to himself with a pose and a flash, buying a teammate a moment; he becomes the first target too.
Fighting style: Fires on call from a distance while a partner covers him up close; retreats once the pain catches up.
Yuga Aoyama (Summer Training).visualDescription: A young man with glossy blond hair in a short, rounded cut with a side-swept fringe, large violet eyes, fair skin and a lean build. He wears the U.A. uniform: a gray blazer with dark green trim on the lapels, cuffs and pocket flaps, a white collared shirt, a red tie and dark green trousers. A bright smile over tired eyes with faint shadows beneath them.
